description: This file defines the HL7SourceValidator class which implements validation logic for HL7Source objects within the OpenMRS project. It utilizes Spring's Validator interface to enforce rules such as non-null name fields and proper field lengths.

classes.name: HL7SourceValidator
classes.description: A validator class for HL7Source objects implementing the Spring Validator interface, with rules for object type support and validation logic.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Determines whether the validator supports validating instances of the given class type.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the given object, checking for nullity, required fields, and field length constraints.
